build_augmentation: build a DensePose augmentation pipeline with random rotation for training from a Detectron2 config
create_DatasetMapper: create a DatasetMapper instance to map Detectron2 dataset dicts with DensePose annotations for training
call_DatasetMapper: run the DatasetMapper on a dataset dict to transform images and DensePose annotations for model input
transform_densepose: transform DensePose annotations using image transforms and DensePose transform data for an instance annotation
add_densepose_masks_as_segmentation: add DensePose coarse segmentation masks as image-level bitmasks for annotations missing segmentation data
